tolerances.reference: Swiss Ephemeris 2.10.03 / pyswisseph 2.10.3.2, Moshier geocentric true equinox of date
tolerances.ayanamsha: Compare the deployed linear TT profile separately from standard Swiss Lahiri; do not silently change production conventions.
tolerances.scope: All active locations on 2026-10-28; representative locations on historical/seasonal/DST dates; independent previous/next roots and boundary ordering.

reference_flags.sun: MOSEPH, apparent geocentric true equinox of date
reference_flags.moon: MOSEPH | TRUEPOS, geocentric true equinox of date

limitations: The primary comparison intentionally shares the documented linear ayanamsha formula, but uses independent solar/lunar ephemerides and boundary searches.
Standard Swiss Lahiri comparison is reported separately; it is not silently substituted for the approved profile.
The matched-timescale run independently evaluates Espenak-Meeus delta-T; the native Swiss timescale comparison is retained separately.
These are numerical cross-engine checks, not validation of every religious observance rule or source identity.
